title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
code: library(shiny) library(safePivot)  ui <- fluidPage(   safePivotOutput("pivot", height = "600px"),   downloadButton("download_csv", "Download CSV"),   downloadButton("download_xlsx", "Download Excel") )  server <- function(input, output, session) {   dat <- reactive(iris)    output$pivot <- renderSafePivot({     safePivot(       dat(),       rows = "Species",       vals = "Sepal.Length",       aggregator = "Median",       renderer = "Table"     )   })    current_pivot <- reactive({     safe_pivot_compute_from_config(       data = dat(),       config = input$pivot_config,       default_rows = "Species",       default_vals = "Sepal.Length",       default_aggregator = "Median"     )   })    output$download_csv <- downloadHandler(     filename = function() "safePivot_result.csv",     content = function(file) {       safe_pivot_write_csv(current_pivot(), file, which = "wide")     }   )    output$download_xlsx <- downloadHandler(     filename = function() "safePivot_result.xlsx",     content = function(file) {       safe_pivot_write_xlsx(current_pivot(), file)     }   ) }  shinyApp(ui, server)

title: What the Package Does (One Line, Title Case)
text: safePivot inspired rpivotTable, R htmlwidget brings PivotTable.js / pivottable.js drag--drop pivot tables R. safePivot takes focused conservative direction: keeps drag--drop table workflow, removes chart renderers adds extra safeguards numeric aggregation, missing values, factor-level ordering, readable heatmaps, Shiny config capture, R-side CSV/Excel/RDS/RData export. also acknowledge PivotTable.js Nicolas Kruchten, underlying JavaScript pivot-table library used interactive browser-side pivot UI.

title: Safe drag-and-drop pivot table htmlwidget — safePivot
text: data data frame. rows Character vector initial row variables. cols Character vector initial column variables. vals Character vector initial value variable. v0.1, use one value variable. aggregator Initial aggregator name. renderer Initial renderer name. Supported values "Table", "Heatmap", "Row Heatmap", "Col Heatmap". missing_label Label used missing categorical values. show_missing_category Whether missing categorical values shown category. respect_factor_order Whether R factor levels control display order. numeric_digits Number digits used displayed numeric values. show_row_totals Whether show row totals table renderers. show_col_totals Whether show column totals table renderers. heatmap_palette Heatmap palette. One "blue", "yellow_orange", "green", "blue_white_red", "green_red". conditional_format Whether apply additional conditional formatting classes numeric pivot cells. high_threshold Relative threshold high-value cell formatting. Values scaled 0 1 within displayed pivot table. low_threshold Relative threshold low-value cell formatting. Values scaled 0 1 within displayed pivot table. max_rows Maximum number rows allowed browser-side pivoting. width Widget width. height Widget height.
